# AI OS

> An open-source foundation for AI-first computing. The long-term goal is a user-owned environment where people and AI agents work together, potentially including a standalone Linux-based desktop; the current release is an early self-hosted coordination workspace, not a desktop operating system.

AI OS connects external agent workers through a workspace API, stateless MCP 2026-07-28 tools (plus legacy 2025-11-25 clients), an A2A discovery card, and reviewed extension metadata. Objectives begin as proposals and require human approval before tasks can be queued or claimed. Workspace credentials isolate data; task reservations and spend limits provide cost guardrails. The browser operations view includes live usage totals, deadline/dependency controls, task recovery, and event history. AI OS does not bundle a model provider or claim to validate provider invoices.

## Start here
- [Project overview](https://github.com/SamsonAssefa/ai-os): features, safety model, setup, and license.
- [User manual](https://github.com/SamsonAssefa/ai-os/blob/main/docs/USER_GUIDE.md): install, configure access, connect agents, approve work, monitor tasks, and recover data.
- [API reference](https://github.com/SamsonAssefa/ai-os/blob/main/docs/API.md): routes, roles, budgets, task lifecycle, and interoperability profiles.
- [OpenAPI schema](https://github.com/SamsonAssefa/ai-os/blob/main/openapi.yaml): machine-readable JSON API contract.
- [Python and JavaScript client quickstarts](https://github.com/SamsonAssefa/ai-os/blob/main/sdks/README.md): dependency-free agent clients and examples.
- [Extension interface](https://github.com/SamsonAssefa/ai-os/blob/main/plugins/README.md): extension metadata, permission labels, review, and optional offline runner.
- [Reference worker](https://github.com/SamsonAssefa/ai-os/blob/main/examples/agent.py): example external worker using environment-provided model credentials.
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/SamsonAssefa/ai-os/blob/main/docs/PRODUCT_ROADMAP.md): current release and next priorities.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/SamsonAssefa/ai-os/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): propose changes and implement integrations.

## Interoperability
- JSON API base path: `/api/v1`.
- Credential identity and UI capabilities: `GET /api/v1/me`; budgets and queue totals: `GET /api/v1/metrics` for owners.
- MCP JSON-RPC endpoint: `POST /mcp`; supports `initialize`, `tools/list`, and `tools/call` for templates, eligible tasks, and proposed objectives.
- A2A discovery card: `GET /.well-known/agent-card.json`.
- A2A proposal profile: `POST /a2a` with `message/send`; it creates a proposed objective, and a human must approve it.
- Static discovery: `/llms.txt`, `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml`, and `/openapi.yaml`.

## Safety and limitations
Credentials are scoped to a workspace; dynamic agent keys bind to a registered agent and are shown only once. The optional Docker runner is disabled by default; it runs reviewed digest-pinned images offline without host mounts or credentials. Browser SSO, rate limiting, managed secrets, full A2A lifecycle, and production hosting controls are not included. Public crawling requires a real public HTTPS host; localhost and repository metadata do not publish the running web app.
